items.format: <scope segment>/<first two hex chars of sha256>/<sha256 hex> (BlobScope::segment())
base64url(json{v,t,d,e,a}) "." base64url(HMAC-SHA256(json, hmac-sha256('vaulter.changes.cursor', app key))); opaque to clients
"<node id>.<sequence>.<first 16 hex of sha256 of the canonical representation>" (strong, quoted)
ULID string (Str::ulid()) assigned when the DomainEvent is built; one value per occurrence (UNIQUE in activity and outbox, with endpoint in deliveries)
X-Vaulter-Api-Version response header on every response
X-Vaulter-Collab-Timestamp (unix seconds) and X-Vaulter-Collab-Signature (lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<timestamp>.<raw body>" with the hub webhook secret); a replayed signature is refused

Idempotency-Key request header: one Structured Field String ("…", \" and \\ escapes) or one token of visible ASCII without commas; 1-255 bytes, never trimmed or case-folded; Idempotent-Replayed: true on a replayed response
X-Request-Id: an accepted incoming id (also read from X-Correlation-Id) or a new ULID; echoed on every response
Tus 1.0.0 resumable uploads: Tus-Resumable, Tus-Version, Tus-Extension (creation,termination), Tus-Max-Size, Upload-Offset, Upload-Length, Upload-Metadata

lowercase hex SHA-256 over tenant_kind, tenant_id, scope_kind, scope_id, actor_kind, actor_id, operation, key, each as <byte length>:<bytes> and a null as ~; request hash = hex SHA-256 of the canonical JSON fingerprint (keys sorted, unescaped slashes/unicode)
If-Match header: one or more strong entity tags; weak tags never match; absent -> 428 precondition_required, no match -> 412
HS256 JWT: sub, node, drive, tenant, epoch, schema_version, mode (rw|ro), room (<channel prefix>.<drive>.<node>.<epoch>), iat, exp

<module>.<resource>.<verb>, dotted lowercase segments, at most 64 bytes (OperationSpec::NAME_PATTERN); one name per mutating operation: documents.comments.add, documents.comments.delete, documents.comments.resolve, documents.documents.create, documents.documents.restore, documents.documents.set_retention, documents.documents.snapshot, documents.documents.update, documents.documents.update_content, drive.access.grant, drive.access.restore_inheritance, drive.access.restrict_inheritance, drive.access.revoke, drive.files.add_revision, drive.files.delete_revision, drive.files.restore_revision, drive.files.set_revision_retention, drive.files.upload, drive.folders.create, drive.nodes.copy, drive.nodes.move, drive.nodes.rename, drive.nodes.set_properties, drive.nodes.star, drive.nodes.trash, drive.nodes.unstar, drive.shares.create, drive.shares.revoke, drive.shares.rotate, drive.shares.update, drive.trash.purge, drive.trash.restore, drive.uploads.abort, drive.uploads.complete, drive.uploads.initiate, webhooks.endpoints.deactivate, webhooks.endpoints.delete, webhooks.endpoints.redeliver, webhooks.endpoints.register, webhooks.endpoints.rotate_secret, webhooks.endpoints.update
receipt kind drive.node-snapshot, version 1: JSON of every NodeSnapshot field (snake_case; times Y-m-d\TH:i:s.uP; file/document/viewer heads or null)
receipt kind vaulter.problem, version 1: JSON {code, status, details} of a refusal whose code is receipt: cacheable; headers in receipt_headers
JSON: id (event id), type, version (1), source (vaulter), time (UTC ms Z), tenant_id, drive_id, subject{type,id}, sequence, actor{type,id}, correlation_id, changes{seq}|null, data (object)
Standard Webhooks headers webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, webhook-signature (v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256>), several secrets space separated during rotation
